definitions.explanation: A flat instrument with straight edges used for measuring length or drawing straight lines.

examples.japanese: {定規|じょうぎ}で{線|せん}を{引|ひ}く。
examples.english: To draw a line with a ruler.

examples.japanese: この{定規|じょうぎ}は30センチまで{測|はか}れる。
examples.english: This ruler can measure up to 30 centimeters.

examples.japanese: {三角|さんかく}{定規|じょうぎ}を{使|つか}って{角度|かくど}を{描|か}いた。
examples.english: I drew an angle using a triangular ruler.
examples.notes: 三角定規 = set square, triangular ruler

notes:
{定規|じょうぎ} refers to a ruler used for measuring or drawing straight lines. The term emphasizes the straightness and precision of the tool.

TYPES OF RULERS:
- {三角|さんかく}{定規|じょうぎ}: set square, triangular ruler
- {直|ちょく}{定規|じょうぎ}: straight ruler
- {分度器|ぶんどき}: protractor (for measuring angles)

RELATED WORDS:
- {物差|ものさ}し: ruler (alternative term, often for longer measuring sticks)
- メジャー: tape measure
